name_zh: 津巴布韦·罗伯特·穆加贝：土地改革独裁与恶性通胀钻石遗产
name_en: Zimbabwe Robert Mugabe: Land Reform Dictatorship & Hyperinflation Diamonds Legacy
description_zh: 罗伯特·穆加贝 (1924-2019) 津巴布韦总统 (1980-2017)，早年解放英雄晚年独裁者，2000年快速土地改革驱逐白人农场主，恶性通胀摧毁经济，马拉维钻石争夺，2017年政变下台。
description_en: Robert Mugabe (1924-2019) Zimbabwe President (1980-2017), early liberation hero late dictator, 2000 fast-track land reform expelled white farmers, hyperinflation destroyed economy, Marange diamonds争夺, 2017 coup ousted.
reason_zh: 穆加贝代表解放英雄如何异化为独裁者，展示了土地改革如何从正义诉求演变为掠夺性掠夺，恶性通胀与钻石资源诅咒双重摧毁了非洲曾经的面包篮子。
reason_en: Mugabe represents how liberation hero mutates into dictator, demonstrating how land reform evolved from justice demand into predatory plunder, hyperinflation and diamond resource curse dual destruction of Africas former breadbasket.
steps_zh: 研究穆加贝早年教师与游击战争领袖
分析1980年独立与兰开斯特宫协议土地条款
探讨2000年快速土地改革与白人农场主驱逐
评估2008年恶性通胀与马拉维钻石军方掠夺
总结土地改革独裁恶性通胀钻石遗产对津巴布韦发展的毁灭性打击
steps_en: Study Mugabe early teacher and guerrilla war leader
Analyze 1980 independence and Lancaster House land clauses
Explore 2000 fast-track land reform and white farmer expulsion
Evaluate 2008 hyperinflation and Marange diamonds military plunder
Summarize land reform dictatorship hyperinflation diamonds legacy devastating blow to Zimbabwe development
expected_zh: 理解解放遗产如何被独权力异化掠夺工具，掌握土地改革从正义到掠夺的异化机制，评估穆加贝遗产对南部非洲民主化与资源治理的警示。
expected_en: Understand how liberation legacy mutates into dictatorial plunder tool, grasp land reform evolution from justice to plunder mechanism, evaluate Mugabe legacy warning for Southern African democratization and resource governance.
case_zh: 1980 独立；2000 土地改革；2008 恶性通胀；2017 政变。土地改革独裁恶性通胀钻石范式永存。
case_en: 1980 independence; 2000 land reform; 2008 hyperinflation; 2017 coup. Land reform dictatorship hyperinflation diamonds paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: Zimbabwean Nationalism / Land Reform / Resource Curse
cross_cultural_impact: Liberation hero to dictator; land reform; hyperinflation; diamond curse
